$\\sigma$ es la letra griega sigma minús:
$\sigma$ is the lower-case Greek letter sigma; $\sigma^2$ is read “sigma squared” and is the variance, and $\sigma$ on its own is the standard deviation.

Read as: “sigma squared equals the sum of the x sub i minus x bar, squared, over N”.

What it does, step by step: it measures how far each datum strays from the mean, squares those distances so that the ones on one side do not cancel the ones on the other, and takes the average. Since squaring leaves odd units — euros squared — at the end you take the root and return to euros: that is the standard deviation.

La desviación típica se interpreta como: The standard deviation is read as “how far a typical datum strays from the mean”. It is in the same units as the data, which is why it is more legible than the variance.
La diferencia entre media y mediana es u: The difference between mean and median is a political matter. If ten people earn 1000 € and one earns a million, the mean says they take home some 91,000 € and the median says 1000 €: only one of the two describes those people's lives. That is why serious reports on wages and house prices always give the median, and why it pays to be suspicious when somebody chooses the mean to talk about incomes.
La dispersión suele importar más que el: Spread usually matters more than the average. Two manufacturing processes with the same mean measurement are very different if one has twice the deviation: that one produces more parts outside tolerance, and from there comes quality control, which watches the standard deviation and not the mean. In an investment, the deviation is literally what is called risk. A river with a pleasant mean flow can flood the village if its spread is large.
La estadística descriptiva hace una cosa: Descriptive statistics does one specific thing: take a pile of data and summarise it in a few numbers that can be understood at a glance. No guessing the future (that is inference); only describing what is there.
La estadística descriptiva resume; no pr: Descriptive statistics summarises; it does not predict.
La media es sensible a los valores extre: The mean is sensitive to extreme values and the median is not. If in a ten-person company nine earn 1500 € and the boss 50,000, the mean says 6350 € and the median says 1500 €. The median describes that workforce far better. When somebody gives you a mean, always ask about the spread.
La media se deja arrastrar por los valor: The mean is dragged about by extreme values; the median is not.
